content: In case of gatewaying, when a successful RxIndication is re- ceived by PduR from the lower layer, the module shall initiate a reception session for a configured upper layer destination: <UpTp>_StartOfReception , <UpTp>_CopyRx Data , and <UpTp>_RxIndication will be called in this order.
